about.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience implementing automation projects. Worked as a consultant implementing Cash Application Automation for 2 years. Being a logical thinker who prioritizes real-world applications over textbook approaches, I have adopted a fail-first and fix-fast approach as a personality trait. Outside of work, I do stand-up comedy to keep following my passion. I am always seeking new adventures, driven by wanderlust and a knack for discovering good food.
